position_selection.phase_definition: phase = opening if ply < 20; midgame if 20 <= ply < 40; endgame if ply >= 40
position_selection.action_type_definition: use chosen_action.type from the canonical action categories: take_tokens, buy_market, buy_reserved, reserve_market, reserve_deck, choose_noble, pass
position_selection.quota_rule: Within each source, allocate 256 slots across phase x action_type x legal_bin strata. Base quota = floor(256 * stratum_count / source_count). Remainders are allocated by descending fractional remainder, then by ascending stratum key. Every non-empty stratum receives at least 1; if this exceeds 256, trim from the largest-quota stratum using ascending deterministic key until total is 256.

deterministic_selector.encoding: UTF-8 concatenation of diagnosis_id and information_set_hash

position_selection.sparse_stratum_rule: Non-empty strata with computed quota 0 receive at least 1; reduction is applied to the stratum with the largest quota, using ascending deterministic key order to choose removed entries.

output.semantic_hash: sha256 of canonical JSON output, to be recorded after selection
